verdict.rationale: The only export-like mechanism is a paid ($175) Long Form Certificate of Status that lists all documents ever filed on the entity, returned by mail by default. That is a certified record, not a data export in open or machine-readable formats, and no API exists (OpenAPI probes 404). missing for 10: self-service bulk export of all entity filings and data, open or machine-readable formats, no-fee digital delivery, documented process for transferring or exiting the entity (e.g., conversion out), independent corroboration.
